data.name: Bangaru
data.gender_notes: Bangaru is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bangara’ which means ‘bull’. The name ‘Bangaru’ is a respectful title given to a wealthy or prosperous man in Indian culture. It is believed that a person named Bangaru is blessed with wealth and prosperity throughout their life. The name Bangaru carries the meaning “Blessed with wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bangaru usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bangaru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bangaru total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: In Indian culture, the image of a bull represents power, strength, and prosperity. A person named Bangaru is often considered to be a symbol of these qualities. They are respected and admired within their community for their financial success and stability.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the bull is also considered a sacred animal and is often associated with the god Shiva. The bull is believed to represent primeval power, strength, and virtue. By carrying the weight of the world on its shoulders, the bull embodies the concept of selfless service and sacrifice. A person named Bangaru can draw inspiration from this symbolism and strive to live a life that upholds these virtues.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Bangaru in Sanskrit translates to 'Golden One'. It symbolizes the inner radiance and purity of an individual, much like pure gold.
